name: Razorpay
showcaseSub: Showcase gateway: no network call is made and no real payment is created.
testModeSub: Razorpay test keys: payments here use test cards and move no real money.
gate: Uses your own Razorpay account. Payments go straight to you, not to this system.
connectHelp: Paste your Razorpay key ID, key secret and webhook secret. They are stored encrypted and never shown again. Start with test keys.
webhookHelp: In the Razorpay dashboard add this URL as a webhook with the same secret, and tick the payment link, payment and refund events.
paymentLinkReused: This deal already has an open payment link.
paymentLinkShareNote: Razorpay does not message your customer. Share the link yourself, only with people who agreed to hear from you.
amountHelp: Amount in {currency}. Stored as whole minor units (paise for INR).
refundsReadOnly: Refunds are made in the Razorpay dashboard. They show here once Razorpay confirms them.
fail.invalid_amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
fail.no_target: Choose a deal, lead or booking for this payment.
fail.deal_not_found: That deal was not found in this workspace.
fail.amount_mismatch: This deal already has an open link for a different amount. Cancel it first.
fail.gateway_rejected: Razorpay refused the request. Check the amount and customer details.
fail.transient: Razorpay is not reachable right now. Try again in a minute.
fail.credentials: Razorpay rejected your keys. Reconnect with fresh keys.
event.payment.mismatch: Payment event did not match and was not applied
